training_method.update_scope_quote: QLoRA fine-tuning (4-bit NF4 base + LoRA, r=128, α=256, all linear layers), then merge_and_unload() into the base

description.text: A full, ready-to-use medical model: Llama-3.1-8B adapted to the medical domain with QLoRA, with the LoRA weights merged back into the base. Load it directly with transformers — no adapter, no PEFT, no extra steps. This is the 8B (high-capacity flagship) member of the Med-LLaMA3 family introduced in the paper “Med-LLaMA3: Advancing Medical Question-Answering Through Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning of Large Language Models” (Applied Sciences, 2026). The 8B variant is the high-capacity model for complex clinical reasoning. It attains a mean accuracy of 75.71% across the eight MMLU medical subsets.

serving.system_prompt: You are a knowledgeable medical assistant. Answer accurately and concisely.
serving.notes: generation_config.json sets do_sample true, temperature 0.6, and top_p 0.9. The card example sets max_new_tokens 256, do_sample false, and temperature 0.0. tokenizer_config.json has no chat_template key; chat_template.jinja is the Llama 3.1 template and leaves the system message empty unless the first message has role system. Training max sequence length on the card is 4096. Gradient accumulation on the card is 4. The safetensors count is 8,030,261,248. The card says out of scope: generating definitive diagnoses, prescriptions, or treatment plans. The example question still asks for a first-line pneumonia treatment.

evaluation_reported.text: 5-shot, LM Evaluation Harness v0.4.2. MMLU medical mean 75.71% (Anatomy 71.11, Clinical Knowledge 79.62, College Biology 84.03, College Medicine 67.63, Medical Genetics 84.00, Nutrition 83.66, Professional Medicine 77.21, Virology 58.43). MedMCQA 61.8, MedQA 62.4, PubMedQA 77.0. Zero-shot NER on 100 MIMIC-III discharge summaries: disease F1 0.92, procedure F1 0.95, macro F1 0.94. Expert review of 100 generative cases: 94% rated Good and 6% contained critical errors.

discrepancies: Inventory method qlora, the YAML dataset list, and the parent match the card. The card and the paper also name MedQuAD and HealthCareMagic, which are not in the inventory string. The card says 5 epochs. The 8B training script sets num_epochs to 6. The paper's data-availability link is the adapter repository MohamedAhmedAE/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct-Medical-Finetuned, not this merged repository id. The paper does not say which Hub copy of MedQuAD was used. Its HealthCareMagic count is 64,246 samples; a table in the same paper lists 112,165.
